author: Wahiz
body:
Ok, so basically I was banned on Ts3 for sending porn links to other users without there consent. At first it was a joke and I was poking it to the user so I didn't see a problem cause it wasn't in public chat. The other reason is other users did it, got a milder punishment or not a punishment at all. (I will not say names) I then talked to Micheal after the fact, and he asked me how I did it and I told him other users were doing it and etc... When I sent It I didn't really think it would cause any problems, but then I found out other users use loopholes in the rules and abused them.  (Would've use proper format, but forums are still bugged)

Staff Member That Banned Me: Resepignev [Mod]
TeamSpeak IGN: Dawson

title: TeamSpeak [Appeal]

replies.author: resepignev
replies.body:
Heey Dawson,

I know that it's tempting to send such links to other users, especially when others did the same, but you have to understand that some of these people don't know that it is a joke and that they find it inappropriate. Especially regarding pornographic sites and images.
Well, it turned out that it's the case. The user reported you and now you have to face the consequences.

I'm not sure what is the minimum amount of time until you can appeal the infraction, but I'll go ahead and say try in to appeal in 1 or 2 months again.

Regards Flo/resepignev.

replies.body:
Hello,

Sorry for the late response, however I've decided to deny your appeal. "You have to understand that some of these people don't know that it is a joke and that they find it inappropriate", plus this content is extremely inappropriate for our younger TeamSpeak users. You may appeal in 2-3 months.

Thanks!
